# Towards Victory — Leaderboard on_action hooks
# Manually maintained — NOT generated by gen_victory.py
#
# tv_leaderboard_monthly_pulse fires once per country per month via monthly_country_pulse.
# It updates per-country best-path variables for all countries (player + AI),
# then triggers a full leaderboard rebuild on the situation scope once per
# human player (idempotent; safe in multiplayer).

tv_leaderboard_monthly_pulse = {
	effect = {
		# ── Cultural Victory: initialise CIP variable if absent ─────────────────────
		if = {
			limit = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_cultural_influence_points }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points value = 0 }
		}

		# ── Arts Exhibition: touring event roll ───────────────────────────────────────
		# Block C: for each touring artist currently in THIS country's court, roll an
		# ~8% monthly chance (~1 event/year) for a touring outcome event on their home
		# country. Weights are stratified by artist_skill (low < 0.5 / mid 0.5–0.7 / high ≥ 0.7).
		every_character = {
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				is_artist = yes
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_ON_EXHIBITION_TT
					has_variable = tv_on_exhibition
				}
			}
			save_scope_as = touring_artist
			# Pre-save home country as a named scope so inner random_list branches can
			# navigate to it reliably. var:X ?= {} silently fails inside nested random_list.
			var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
				save_scope_as = touring_home
			}
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:touring_home }
				# ~8% monthly chance (~1 event per artist per year).
				# Outer random_list: 92 = no event, 8 = pick an outcome from the inner list.
				random_list = {
					92 = {}
					8 = {
						random_list = {
							# ── Unremarkable +0.1 ──────────────────────────────────────
							40 = {
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.101 }
								}
							}
							# ── Great Success +0.5 (skill-boosted) ─────────────────────
							15 = {
								trigger = { artist_skill < 0.5 }
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.102 }
								}
							}
							25 = {
								trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.5  artist_skill < 0.7 }
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.102 }
								}
							}
							40 = {
								trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.7 }
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.102 }
								}
							}
							# ── Terrible −0.1 (skill-reduced) ──────────────────────────
							30 = {
								trigger = { artist_skill < 0.5 }
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.103 }
								}
							}
							15 = {
								trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.5  artist_skill < 0.7 }
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.103 }
								}
							}
							5 = {
								trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.7 }
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.103 }
								}
							}
							# ── Artist Hired +1.0, stays permanently ───────────────────
							5 = {
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.104 }
								}
							}
							# ── Inspiration: +10% artist_skill_level_gain for 10 years ─
							10 = {
								scope:touring_home = {
									trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.105 }
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}

				# ── Event 201: Cultural Diplomacy (1/300 per month, once-per-tour) ─────────────
				if = {
					limit = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
							NOT = { has_variable = tv_tour_event_1_fired }
						}
					}
					random_list = {
						299 = {}
						1 = {
							set_variable = { name = tv_tour_event_1_fired value = 1 }
							scope:touring_home = {
								trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.201 }
							}
						}
					}
				}

				# ── Event 202: Exhibition Success — location buff (1/300, once-per-tour) ────────
				if = {
					limit = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
							NOT = { has_variable = tv_tour_event_2_fired }
						}
					}
					random_list = {
						299 = {}
						1 = {
							set_variable = { name = tv_tour_event_2_fired value = 1 }
							scope:touring_home = {
								trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.202 }
							}
						}
					}
				}

				# ── Event 203: Noble Patron — construct theater (1/300, once-per-tour) ─────────
				if = {
					limit = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
							NOT = { has_variable = tv_tour_event_3_fired }
						}
					}
					random_list = {
						299 = {}
						1 = {
							set_variable = { name = tv_tour_event_3_fired value = 1 }
							scope:touring_home = {
								trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.203 }
							}
						}
					}
				}

				# ── Event 204: Artist Exchange (1/300, once-per-tour, needs target artist) ──────
				if = {
					limit = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
							NOT = { has_variable = tv_tour_event_4_fired }
						}
						var:tv_exhibition_target_country ?= {
							any_character = { is_alive = yes  is_artist = yes  this != scope:touring_artist }
						}
					}
					random_list = {
						299 = {}
						1 = {
							set_variable = { name = tv_tour_event_4_fired value = 1 }
							scope:touring_home = {
								trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.204 }
							}
						}
					}
				}

				# ── Event 205: Art Theft + Artist Dies (1/300, once-per-tour, needs artwork) ────
				if = {
					limit = {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
							NOT = { has_variable = tv_tour_event_5_fired }
						}
						var:tv_exhibition_target_country ?= {
							any_work_of_art_in_country = { always = yes }
						}
					}
					random_list = {
						299 = {}
						1 = {
							set_variable = { name = tv_tour_event_5_fired value = 1 }
							var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
								trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.205 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		# ── Research Mechanism monthly pulse ────────────────────────────────────────
		if = {
			limit = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_ACADEMY_IO_MEMBER_TT
					has_variable = tv_academy_io_member
				}
			}

			# ── Selection cooldown countdown ───────────────────────────────────
			if = {
				limit = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_RESEARCH_SELECTION_CD_TT
						has_variable = tv_research_selection_cd
					}
					var:tv_research_selection_cd >= 1
				}
				change_variable = { name = tv_research_selection_cd add = -1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_research_selection_cd <= 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_research_selection_cd
				}
			}

			# ── Sub-process B: passive prerequisite check (phase 1 only) ──────
			# Phase 4 stub: tv_research_check_b_trigger = always, so B auto-completes
			# on the first monthly tick after a research target is confirmed.
			if = {
				limit = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_RESEARCH_PHASE_TT
						has_variable = tv_research_phase
					}
					var:tv_research_phase = 1
					NOT = { var:tv_rm_subprocess_b >= 2 }
					tv_research_check_b_trigger = yes
				}
				tv_research_complete_b_effect = yes
			}
		}

		# Only run leaderboard logic once the situation is active
		if = {
			limit = { exists = situation:tv_victory_situation }
			# Update this country's leading path / milestone / score for leaderboard display
			tv_update_best_path_effect = yes

			# Human player pulse: rebuild the global top-5 leaderboard on the situation scope
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				situation:tv_victory_situation = {
					tv_update_leaderboard_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}

		# ── Medicine: display stats (always when CS is appointed) ─────────────
		if = {
			limit = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_ACADEMY_IO_MEMBER_TT
					has_variable = tv_academy_io_member
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_ACADEMY_LEADER_CHAR_TT
					has_variable = tv_academy_leader_char
				}
				var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
			}
			tv_update_chief_scientist_effective_adm_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_adm  value = var:tv_scientist_effective_adm }
			set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_dip  value = var:tv_academy_leader_char.dip }
			set_variable = { name = tv_med_disp_mil  value = var:tv_academy_leader_char.mil }
		}

		# ── Medicine: monthly treatment processing ─────────────────────────────
		if = {
			limit = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_ACADEMY_IO_MEMBER_TT
					has_variable = tv_academy_io_member
				}
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_MED_TARGET_CHAR_TT
					has_variable = tv_med_target_char
				}
			}
			# Detect natural death of patient
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:tv_med_target_char ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_medicine.4 }
				tv_med_cleanup_effect = yes
			}
			# Patient alive: accumulate progress and check completion
			else_if = {
				limit = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_ACADEMY_LEADER_CHAR_TT
					has_variable = tv_academy_leader_char
				}
				var:tv_academy_leader_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_MED_PROGRESS_TT
					has_variable = tv_med_progress
				}
			}
				tv_update_chief_scientist_effective_adm_effect = yes
				set_local_variable = { name = med_gain  value = var:tv_scientist_effective_adm }
				change_local_variable = { name = med_gain  multiply = 0.1 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_med_progress  add = local_var:med_gain }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_med_progress >= 100 }
					tv_med_complete_treatment_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}

		# ── Diplomatic Unlock Notification Events ────────────────────────────
		# Fire informational event when DVP reaches 50 (support system unlocked)
		if = {
			limit = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_DIPLOMATIC_VICTORY_POINTS_TT
					has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_points
				}
				var:tv_diplomatic_victory_points >= 50
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplo_unlock_notified }
				}
				# Only fire if M1 hasn't been reached yet (support count < 10)
				OR = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_support_count }
					}
					var:tv_diplomatic_support_count < 10
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_diplo_unlock_notified value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = tv_diplo_alliance.1
		}

		# Fire informational event when support count reaches 10
		if = {
			limit = {
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_DIPLOMATIC_SUPPORT_COUNT_TT
					has_variable = tv_diplomatic_support_count
				}
				var:tv_diplomatic_support_count >= 10
				custom_tooltip = {
					text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
					NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplo_support_notified }
				}
				# Only fire if M1 hasn't been reached yet
				OR = {
					custom_tooltip = {
						text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_diplomatic_milestone }
					}
					var:tv_diplomatic_milestone < 1
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_diplo_support_notified value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = tv_diplo_alliance.2
		}
	}

}
